retention: SD primary; hidden eMMC backup retains latest three sessions
limitations: Physical SD removal under load was not tested. In-flight data and FAT metadata can be lost; stop and wait for save acknowledgement before removal.
Full physical power cycle after this deployment was not performed; automatic start was verified by backend restart, and pre-update physical boot already started MCU SD recording.
Display corruption after battery replacement recovered by display restart; user confirmed normal display.
Startup CAN overflow remains a previously observed limitation, not fixed in this change.
